name: Source-to-decision retention gate
decision: A source or pattern may become retained KRN knowledge only when it states mechanism, KRN implication, decision or rejection, consumer, falsifier, and does-not-prove boundary.
falsifier: A retained source, pattern, or catalog card can omit mechanism, consumer, falsifier, or does-not-prove while still passing the relevant pattern/readback guard.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove source truth, research completeness, ranking quality, or product readiness.
